definitions.total_paired_questions: Number of questions with successful runs in both modes (last successful attempt used).
definitions.total_claims_evaluated: Total atomic claims decomposed from the draft answers of the paired runs.
definitions.baseline_contradicted_claims: Number of claims labeled CONTRADICTED prior to repair (proxy for baseline generation).
definitions.full_contradicted_claims: Number of claims labeled CONTRADICTED after repair pipeline.
definitions.baseline_unsupported_claims: Number of claims labeled UNVERIFIABLE prior to repair.
definitions.full_unsupported_claims: Number of claims labeled UNVERIFIABLE after repair pipeline.
definitions.contradiction_reduction_pct: Percentage reduction strictly in CONTRADICTED claims: (Baseline - Full) / Baseline.
definitions.repair_opportunities: Number of claims that entered the repair/expansion loop.
definitions.successful_repairs: Number of claims successfully converted to SUPPORTED.
definitions.collateral_damage_observations: Automated pipeline observation of originally SUPPORTED claims degrading to an unsupported state.
definitions.avg_latency_baseline_sec: Mean latency of the baseline mode over paired questions.
definitions.avg_latency_full_sec: Mean latency of the full mode over paired questions.
definitions.added_latency_overhead_sec: Absolute latency overhead of the full pipeline (Full - Baseline).
